b.txt.content:
The lighthouse stood alone on the granite headland.
Every night its lamp swept a slow arc across the water.
Fishermen steered by that pale beam for sixty years.
The keeper climbed the spiral stairs at dusk without fail.
When the fog rolled in, the bell answered the darkness.
